_comment: Hierarchical MILP AllGather on rail_optimized_256gpu_dual_plane with switch copy. 256-GPU rail-optimized dual-plane fabric. Every GPU has a port into both planes, so every host transit is co-located (forward dwell 1). Hierarchical only. milp_chunking=4: one MILP chunk = 4 of a host's 8 identities for one destination-cell set, so 2 chunks per host -- between 'holder' (8, intractable here) and 'cell' (1, voids multipath across the 8 uplinks). Bundles span holder GPUs, so three GPUs of each group of four stage through the NVSwitch. switch_copy [true, false]: the network switches of the coarse level copy -- a fan-out is one Send, charged once on its uplink, and ncclize emits it as ONE multicast send threadblock (tb send="r1,r2") with one mscclflowid, plus a switch-JSON (format 2) entry listing every out port; the cell NVSwitches do not copy (multicast there needs NVLS). Pass --no-multicast to ncclize for the pre-multicast output (one unicast send per branch). SLOWEST_LINK keeps every coarse link at >= 1 chunk/epoch (occupancy 1: no multi-epoch legs). objective_type 6 (LEXICOGRAPHIC) puts makespan first; PAPER (3) ties on it. Outputs: Schedules/<prefix>_flat.json (+ _coarse/_identities/_intra side outputs). The switch_no_drop arm of an A/B on the switch rule; the other arm is the b4_nows input, identical but for this flag and the output names. switch_no_drop true: a switch must forward everything that reaches it ('==' in place of '>='), so the model holds no dead flow at a switch. Every switch here copies and there is one pace class, so that is two extra rows per (switch, chunk, epoch) -- inflow <= sum(outs) and inflow <= 1 -- and no new variables: 12,288 rows on top of 462,560 (root model fingerprint 0x27b909cf, against 0xf6ba0820 for b4_nows). Why: in the 2026-11-09 b4_nows run at num_epochs 19 the switch_chain tier took 3 h 47 min of 6 h without closing (4221 entries against a bound of 64), and 1171 entries were left after pruning, i.e. most of that objective was dead flow no higher tier charges for. Compare, per tier, the wall time and work units, and the value the switch_chain tier starts from ('Loaded user MIP start with objective ...') and ends at. No warmstart and no objective_tier_time_limit, as in the other arm. num_epochs 8 IS the ingress bound (62 chunks into 8 in-links of 1 chunk/epoch), so no horizon past it can help; the leaf broadcast (2 columns per cell over 8 leaves) also takes 8, and the 2026-11-10 dual-plane b4_nows run (solved at 19) finished in exactly 8. symmetry false: no twin-switch flow-equality rows and no switch 'inflow == max(outs)' rule. Both restrict the model (neither is exact for a MILP), and the second costs a gp.max_ per copying-switch row. chunk_symmetry_breaking (default on) orders a host's interchangeable chunks instead, which is exact. See teccl/hierarchy/milp_design.md and teccl/ncclize/multicast_output_design.md.
